test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48e09e6c6006cb0cfb6f61e6ba40a07d9996c3c1d1077b6bc25e454b4f2a2332.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) BH − TQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3823690b9f62cef7eb355a8d8ee51974cb6e3c4225006fb1795c61a42b905f21.png] 

Option 2) WC − OL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02538b6ad62122c5a4a7159d08b2ec8180cb6ed76feccdb492d20b7f1f4901df.png] 

**Option 3) HM − ZW**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6db177938a01ad3069aa3e16d7b9d1dbcb1b828bc7687a1d37cf6e668d204b1d.png] 

Option 4) SY − KH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35e0b709a32de6e7b7e3df942349c073c552c36b4992877d254bd61d73a7fe5d.png] 

Here, **HM − ZW** is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
